assessments.summary: The conjunctive claim is not fully established. Conditional on the stated transcription, factorization, and completeness of the term inventory, the 30-row expansion and R0=0 specialization, input-only product marginalization, extended-real inequalities, Q0 channel reduction, and finiteness of V0 are mathematically sound. However, exact fidelity to the primary-source PDF and the asserted fail-closed, render-complete semantic certification remain unverified, so the all-or-nothing claim cannot be rated valid.
scopeQualifications: The 30-row count is correct conditional on the transcription: 26 rows from equations (19a)–(19p), plus four scalar rows from the two side conditions.
The local row equivalence after setting R0=0 is correct conditional on the encoded equations; the mutual-information chain-rule normalization used is valid.

Product marginalization preserves the system conditional on the stated factorization and a complete inventory containing only single-output terms; no audited term may jointly involve G and K or condition one output on the other.
The inequalities V_Q(G,K) <= V(1/2;G,K) <= B(G,K) follow directly from feasible-set inclusion and the supremum definition, including the convention sup(empty set)=-infinity.
The Q0 reduction is valid conditional on completeness of the term list: every supported row depends on the channels through (c,g,k,c), with c=h2(1/4)-1/2.
The explicit feasible zero-rate construction and binary-output entropy bounds establish that V0 is nonempty, bounded, and finite.
evidenceIssues: The committed GK-outer.pdf bytes and an independently authenticated copy were not supplied.
No successful governed-verifier output, signed attestation, or other auditable execution record was supplied; verification.json only specifies an execution setup.
The claimed PDF digest, byte length, xref/object profile, page glyph stream, equation comparisons, and final 30-row comparison therefore cannot be checked.
SOURCE_TRANSCRIPTION.md is part of the contribution under audit and is not independent evidence of the absent source PDF's contents.

The renderer inventories encrypted Type1 CharString names but does not decode and execute each glyph outline, so glyph names and ToUnicode mappings do not by themselves prove painted visual semantics.
Pinned font hashes lack an independent certificate connecting the font bytes to the claimed glyph outlines.
Glyph rectangles derive from FontBBox rather than actual CharString outlines, leaving painted-shape containment, clipping, and nonoverlap uncertified.
The geometry digest binds extractor metadata and derived rectangles, not actual rendering or glyph-outline semantics.
